name: Donald Trump
summary: Trump is a right-populist and nationalist Republican whose program centers on tariffs and trade protection, mass deportation and restricted immigration, deregulation and tax cuts, fossil-fuel expansion, a larger military, and an assertive use of executive power. He treats social issues in a conservative direction (two sexes, an end to DEI, abortion left to states) while having shifted over time on several of them. In foreign policy he combines skepticism of international bodies and allies with unilateral force and territorial ambitions.

notes: The October 2026 passes used campaign platforms, executive orders, Davos speeches and reports on Trump’s first and second presidencies. This pass checked the Miller Center speech collection, the 2017 inaugural address, Crippled America, and signed presidential records against the expanded statement bank. Research covered intervention and alliances, election rules, taxes and retirement, trade and inflation, immigration, policing and political violence, religion and schools, equality and gender policy, energy and emissions, and restrictions on advanced technology. The review histories preserve earlier answers where later evidence changes them or the original evidence did not settle the exact claim.

booksNotUsed.file: Donald Trump - Midas Touch [with Robert T. Kiyosaki] (2011).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: The coauthored book gives entrepreneurial advice on starting and growing a business. Its practical recommendations do not establish positions on labor law or the organization of the economy.

booksNotUsed.file: Donald Trump - The Art of the Deal (1987).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: The memoir focuses on real estate deals and negotiation. Accounts of how Trump pursued particular projects do not settle the scope of legal rights for residential landowners or a general policy on development vetoes.

booksNotUsed.file: Donald Trump - Why We Want You to Be Rich, Two Men, One Message [with Robert T. Kiyosaki] (2006).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: The coauthored book chiefly recommends financial education and investment strategies for individuals. The presidential record and the policy book provide more direct evidence on federal taxes, benefits and retirement policy.

booksNotUsed.file: Naomi Klein - Klein, Naomi - Donald Trump and the Rule of Pampered Princelings (2018).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: Klein’s argument about inherited wealth and power is her analysis. It does not give Trump’s own position on inheritance as a basis for political authority.

booksNotUsed.file: Naomi Klein - Klein, Naomi - Donald Trump's Destruction of the Paris Climate Accord (2017).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: Klein comments on the Paris withdrawal. The withdrawal itself and the presidential statements documenting it are closer evidence.

booksNotUsed.file: Naomi Klein - Klein, Naomi - How Donald Trump Exploited the New York Debt Crisis... (2017).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: The essay interprets Trump’s conduct during the New York fiscal crisis. His demands for particular development deals do not establish a general position on municipal ownership or zoning.

booksNotUsed.file: Naomi Klein - Klein, Naomi - The Worst of Donald Trump's Toxic Agenda Is Lying in Wait (2017).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: The essay anticipates what the administration might do. Signed orders and laws provide evidence of what Trump actually did.

booksNotUsed.file: Trump Revealed, The Definitive Biography of the 45th President (2017) (about Donald Trump, by Michael Kranish and Marc Fisher).txt
booksNotUsed.reason: The biography covers the business career and first campaign. It is secondary and predates the governing record relied on for the positions audited here.
The matching rows identify Trump as President in the chamber field. He did not serve in the House or Senate and these entries do not represent congressional roll calls cast by him.

The remaining transcripts were screened for quiz topics. Where they announce actions, the audit prioritizes the orders and laws themselves. Their other material is duplicative, event-specific or does not settle an additional position.
